verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS AI coding assistant that holds chat histories, agent sessions, custom agents and settings, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a data-export feature, export formats, or an account-exit path. The nearest items are the training opt-out and audit logs, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
